description:
Previews how a selected saved resume relates to a specific job. Tailoring identifies a requirement and
suggests how to make existing evidence clearer. Fit reports supported evidence and a gap where available.
Cover letter offers a starting point grounded in an actual experience and the posting. The preview is read-only.
resume_id selects an owned resume version. Without it the tool uses the primary or only resume, or returns choices.
The result can include an exact website continuation and whether opening it saves the job in the tracker.
This preview requires permission to share saved resume evidence. Resume parsing is a separate resume_check workflow.
name: job_application_preview
title: Preview help with a job application
